task.title: Fix activity logging when Prepare Email Draft is clicked
task.description: In sendEmail(qid), after calling openEmailCompose() and before returning, write an activity record. Current sendEmail() calls markSentSilent(qid) and renderQueue() — keep that. Additionally ensure the activity record includes reason and trigger from the queue item. The markSentSilent function already writes to activity — verify it includes item.reason in the record. If not, update markSentSilent to include reason: s(K.activity,[...ga(),{id:uid(),cId:item.cId,cName:item.cName,co:item.co,msg:item.msg,trigger:item.trigger,reason:item.reason||'',ts:new Date().toISOString()}]); Also remove the standalone Mark Sent button from queue item cards — keep only Send Email Draft, Refine, Save Draft, and Remove buttons. Mark Sent should only appear in the contact history modal.

blocking_issues: No focus management for modals - keyboard users cannot navigate or close modals with ESC key, violating WCAG 2.1.1
Modal close buttons use × symbol without aria-label, making them inaccessible to screen readers
No skip-to-content link - keyboard users must tab through entire sidebar navigation to reach main content
Form inputs lack associated error announcements - screen readers won't detect validation errors
Clickable table rows lack keyboard accessibility (no tabindex, no enter/space handlers)
Color is sole indicator for priority/tier badges and stat values - fails WCAG 1.4.1 for colorblind users
Sidebar navigation lacks proper ARIA landmarks and current page indication for screen readers
Mobile navigation completely inaccessible - 230px fixed sidebar with no hamburger menu or responsive collapse mechanism will block content on small screens
Modal scrolling broken on mobile - .modal-box max-height:92vh with padding:36px causes content cut-off and no proper scroll handling on iOS Safari
Form inputs lack accessible labels - aria-labels or visible labels missing for screen readers in login form and modals
Fixed toast position (bottom:24px left:24px) will overlap with mobile UI elements and is not responsive
No keyboard navigation support - modals lack focus trap, escape key handling not visible, tab order not managed
AI Guide modal (#guideModal) is not responsive on mobile - fixed width 340px and fixed positioning will overflow on small screens (<375px) and block critical app content
